recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中可見右側一團深染的骨髓顆粒（marrow particle）及左側拖曳的細胞帶；在此放大倍率下無法清楚分辨纏繞於顆粒內的微絲蟲，需高倍確認。
features: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear through an eyepiece
Dense, deeply basophilic marrow particle with fat vacuoles at the right
Cellular trails streaming away from the particle toward the left
A microfilaria is not distinctly resolved within the particle at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular marrow particle containing fat vacuoles and cellular trails extending from it. At this magnification and image quality, the microfilaria described as entangled within the particle cannot be distinctly identified; high-power examination of the particle edges is required. In the stated clinical context of pancytopenia with microfilariae seen in blood and marrow, the image documents the particle in which the parasite was found, but it is not independently diagnostic of filariasis.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strands or stromal fibers within a particle
ddx.vs: Fibrin and stroma lack the organized body with column of somatic nuclei and tapering tail seen in a microfilaria at high power.
Only a high-power search showing a sheathed or unsheathed larva with nuclei confirms microfilaria; low power cannot separate them.
